definitions.explanation: A collective term for the three types of basic local government units in Japan: cities (市), towns (町), and villages (村). Used in administrative, political, and geographical contexts.

examples.japanese: {全国|ぜんこく}の{市町村|しちょうそん}に{通知|つうち}を{出|だ}した。
examples.english: A notification was sent to municipalities nationwide.

examples.japanese: {市町村|しちょうそん}{合併|がっぺい}により、{自治体|じちたい}の{数|かず}が{減|へ}っている。
examples.english: The number of local governments is decreasing due to municipal mergers.

examples.japanese: {各|かく}{市町村|しちょうそん}が{独自|どくじ}の{子育|こそだ}て{支援|しえん}{制度|せいど}を{設|もう}けている。
examples.english: Each municipality has established its own childcare support system.

notes:
USAGE:
{市町村|しちょうそん} is a compound of {市|し} (city), {町|ちょう} (town), and {村|そん} (village). These are the basic units of local government in Japan, below the prefectural ({都道府県|とどうふけん}) level.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {市町村|しちょうそん}{合併|がっぺい} (municipal merger)
- {市町村|しちょうそん}{長|ちょう} (mayor of a municipality)
- {市町村|しちょうそん}{役場|やくば} (municipal office)
- {各|かく}{市町村|しちょうそん} (each municipality)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{自治体|じちたい} means local government or municipality in a broader sense and can include prefectures. {市町村|しちょうそん} specifically refers to the three types of basic local units.
